name: weekly-review
prompt: Produce the weekly founder briefing. Pull KPI deltas from business/knowledge-base/kpis.yaml. Scan Linear for issues that slipped sprint, stale issues > 14 days in 'In Progress', and the top 5 issues moving next week. Scan GitHub for PRs open > 7 days and PRs merged this week. Scan Notion for new specs in 'in-review'. Run the customer health check per business/sops/cs/health-check.md and include the red list. Produce a one-page briefing with three sections in this order: WINS, BLOCKERS, DECISIONS NEEDED. Each decision must be phrased as a binary choice with the recommendation. Post to #cos.
